post.description:

**Notes:** Side effect: places a real phone call. Upstream: https://api.acefone.in/v1/users for agent lookup and ACEFONE_CLICK_TO_CALL_URL (default https://api.acefone.in/v1/click_to_call). Writes an acefone_fallback.log file on the server when the softphone is offline.

get.summary: Compare answer rates before/after dedicated DIDs
get.description:
Builds a per-vendor before/after answer-rate report from vendor_call_daily_stats, with vendors still on the shared DID acting as a control group. Returns treatment, control and pooled figures in percentage points.

**Notes:** Reads pre-ingested stats only, never calls Acefone live. force-dynamic. Shared DID number comes from DID_NUMBER (default 918065927449). Control vendors need >= 30 inbound calls on both sides.

get.summary: List cost entries for a provider account
get.description:
Returns up to 500 CostEntry rows for one provider account, newest entry date first, optionally narrowed by a date range and entry type. Each row carries the native amount plus the INR and USD amounts frozen at insert time.

**Notes:** Admin session enforced by requireAdminSession() (NextAuth cookie). Hard cap of 500 rows - there is no paging.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/accounts/[id]/entries/route.ts`_

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on entryDate. Unparseable values are ignored.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: subscription | usage | one_time | credit | refund. Any other value is silently ignored.

post.summary: Add a manual cost entry to an account
post.description:
Records a spend line against a provider account. The native amount is stored as the audit source of truth and is also converted to INR and USD at the current exchange rate at insert time.

**Notes:** Admin session required. Entries are stamped source='manual' and createdById from the session. Currency conversion uses the cached exchange rate (see /api/cost-monitor/exchange-rate/refresh); the converted columns are frozen and are NOT re-computed if the rate later changes.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/accounts/[id]/entries/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

example.error: currency must be USD or INR

get.summary: List subscriptions on a provider account
get.description:
Returns every CostSubscription for the account, ordered by endDate (nulls first, i.e. still-active subscriptions) then by next renewal date.

**Notes:** Admin session required.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/accounts/[id]/subscriptions/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

post.summary: Create a subscription on an account
post.description:
Adds a recurring cost subscription (autoRenew is always set true) and immediately writes one CostEntry for the current billing period so the dashboard reflects the spend right away.

**Notes:** Admin session required. SIDE EFFECT: also creates a CostEntry (type 'subscription', source 'manual', externalRef 'subscription:<id>') dated today, or dated startDate when startDate is in the future. A scheduled job rolls further entries forward as renewals pass. autoRenew cannot be set to false through this endpoint.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/accounts/[id]/subscriptions/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

example.error: billingCycle must be monthly | quarterly | yearly | one_time

post.description:
Admin-triggered FX refresh: pulls the latest USD to INR rate, stores it, and returns both the refresh result and the newest stored rate row. Takes no parameters.

**Notes:** Admin session required. Calls an external FX provider and writes a CostExchangeRate row. maxDuration is 30s. The cron equivalent is POST /api/cron/cost-monitor/exchange-rate, which uses bearer auth instead but calls the same helper. ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

label.description: Account label. Must be non-empty when supplied; unique per provider.

externalAccountId.description: Provider-side account id. Send an empty string or null to clear.

notes.description: Free-form notes. Send an empty string or null to clear.

customerNumber.description: Customer phone; 10-digit numbers are prefixed with 91

entryDate.description: ISO date the cost was incurred

amount.description: Non-zero amount; changing it re-runs the FX conversion

currency.description: USD or INR; changing it re-runs the FX conversion

externalRef.description: Provider invoice reference; empty string clears it to null

scopeRef.description: Required (and must exist) for category and provider scopes: a CostProvider category name, or a provider slug. Forced to null for the global scope.

monthlyBudget.description: Monthly cap; must be greater than 0

currency.description: USD or INR. Defaults to INR.

alertThreshold.description: Fraction of the budget at which to alert, in (0, 1]. Defaults to 0.8.

amount.description: Recurring amount; must be greater than 0

nextRenewalDate.description: ISO date of the next renewal

seats.description: Seat count; must be a positive integer when supplied

entryDate.description: ISO date the cost was incurred

amount.description: Non-zero amount in the given currency. Negative values are allowed (credits/refunds).

type.description: subscription | usage | one_time | credit | refund (lower-cased before validation)

externalRef.description: Invoice or reference id from the provider

metadata.description: Accepted by the body interface but not persisted by this handler

OkErrorEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ ok: false, error }` used by cron / sync style routes.

monthlyBudget.description: Monthly cap; must be greater than 0

alertThreshold.description: Fraction of the budget at which to alert; must be in (0, 1], e.g. 0.8 for 80%

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerErrorOkFlag.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure. Variant for routes that use the `{ ok, error }` envelope.

UnauthorizedOkFlag.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session. Variant for routes that use the `{ ok, error }` envelope.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
